newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to decide on MOL sale next week.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to decide on MOL sale next week.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV will decide next week on a public offering of shares in the oil and gas company MOL, the Hungarian economic news agency MTI-Econews said on Tuesday, quoting APV managing director Gyorgy Valyi.

APV is expected to offer a 12 to 18 percent stake in MOL to domestic and international investors in 1997. Econews said the lead manager of the planned international placement would be Kleinwort Benson.
APV holds some 60 percent of the company.
The state plans to retain a stake of 25 percent plus one vote in MOL once the company's privatisation is finished.
MOL closed at 1835 forints, unchanged, on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
